categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Lian Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of injection molded products and precision injection molds. Its products serve key sectors including consumer electronics, toys and daily necessities, automotive parts, and medical devices. The company operates as an integrated precision manufacturing enterprise covering industrial design, mold design, manufacturing, injection molding, coating, and assembly.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as rapid prototyping, high-speed machining, ultra-precision processing, and digital mold design. It emphasizes high precision with mold cavity processing accuracy up to ±0.001mm and mold lifespan reaching 1.5 million cycles. Production involves strict quality control systems and employs automated assembly and coating processes. R&D focuses on polymer material preparation, automation, and high-precision mold development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are mainly in consumer electronics, toys and daily products, automotive components, and medical instruments. Notable clients include Logitech Group, Hikvision, Preh, Minth Group, and Aikang Bio. The company’s products are integral to electronic device casings, toy components, automotive covers, and medical device parts, serving both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing bases in Ningbo and Hefei, and has overseas subsidiaries in Singapore and Vietnam. Domestic sales account for approximately 74% of revenue, while international sales, mainly to North America and Southeast Asia, represent about 26%. The Vietnam facility, operational since 2024, is undergoing capacity ramp-up.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Lian Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on precision mold manufacturing and injection molding of plastic parts. It procures raw materials like plastic granules and mold steel, and supplies finished injection molded components and molds to downstream manufacturers and OEMs in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with sustained R&D investment (~5.6% of revenue). Key R&D areas include smart assembly robotics, flame-retardant and lightweight polymer alloys, high-temperature ceramic elastomers, antibacterial composite materials, reversible thermochromic plastics, and injection molding equipment enhancements. It also emphasizes PCR recycled plastics application and deepens collaborations with universities for advanced material and AI technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of injection molded products and precision injection molds. The company signs sales contracts or orders directly with customers, often involving separate contracts and fees for mold development, manufacturing, and after-sales maintenance. It operates on a make-to-order basis, with some outsourced processing to supplement capacity.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading precision injection molding and mold manufacturing enterprise in China, recognized as a national high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise. It holds a strong market position with long-term contracts with major global brands like Logitech, indicating competitive advantages in technology, quality, and customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 511.8 million, a 9% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 65.8 million, a 13% decline mainly due to rising labor costs and initial underutilization of the Vietnam plant. Total assets grew 52% to nearly RMB 998 million, and shareholders’ equity nearly doubled to RMB 783 million. The company maintains positive operating cash flow and has recently completed a successful IPO raising over RMB 331 million net proceeds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Lian Technology emphasizes high-precision manufacturing capabilities, advanced mold design and processing technologies, and stringent quality control systems certified by ISO9001, ISO14001, and IATF16949. Its products feature superior mold cavity accuracy and durability, enabling production of high-quality plastic parts for demanding applications. The company’s strong R&D and innovation culture, coupled with stable relationships with leading global customers, underpin its competitive differentiation.
